1.mascotDialogue: Same visited-tracking idea as BFS, an entirely different order of operations — DFS dives deep first and only comes back up when it genuinely has to.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6 is the whole difference from BFS: instead of queuing the neighbour for later, DFS recurses into it immediately, going deep before ever checking the next sibling.

3.mascotDialogue: Same graph as the BFS lesson, an entirely different order — 3 gets visited before 2, because DFS committed to 1 first and rode that path all the way down.

4.mascotDialogue: DFS's recursive elegance is also its biggest risk: forget the visited check and 'go deep' has no bottom to hit. It simply keeps calling itself, indefinitely.
